# #1655: Patch: per-card cosmetic picks, worn by the viewer's own cards on the board and in the inspect preview
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part of #1651 (brief §6, first and third bullets). Today the card cosmetics are one pick per kind for all of a player's cards (`apps/web/src/cards/cosmetics.ts`, R1295000), only the board's own cards wear them (`game/wearer.ts`, `game/Card.tsx` ~l.447), the hover preview and inspect overlays draw the defaults, and full art is one global setting gated by ownership (`cards/fullArt.ts`, R1313000). This part makes foil, finish, border and full-art face **equipped per card**, and makes the viewer's own copy wear its picks wherever it is drawn as theirs. A sibling part builds the Collection view that sets the picks on the API below; this part's ruling covers both.

### Decided here
- **Where the picks live.** Per-card picks are a device store beside the account defaults: localStorage `jackioh.cosmetics.cards.v1`, read and written by `cards/cosmetics.ts`, keeping unknown ids as `normalizeCosmetics` does. The `cosmetics` settings group that syncs to the account (`settings/groups.ts`, R633, R634) keeps exactly its six keys and shape, so an old client and a new one never overwrite each other's picks. Rejected: a synced per-card group (the server holds at most `PLAYER_SETTINGS_KEYS_MAX` = 32 keys a group and `PLAYER_SETTINGS_BYTES_MAX` = 4096 bytes, mirrored in migration 0018: a handful of cards), raising those limits, or a server equip table (each a migration). Per-card picks therefore stay on the device; the account defaults still roam.
- **Fallback.** A card with no pick of a kind wears the account default: today's pick for foil, finish and border, and the Full-art cards setting for full art.
- **Ownership.** A per-card pick is worn only when the viewer owns that cosmetic on that card (a default or a starter counts, and so does a ledger row from `GET /api/cosmetics`, `getOwnedCosmetics`), or where every cosmetic counts as owned: practice, hotseat and the builds R1310004 opens. Widen `FullArtOwned` / `ownsFullArt` and `cards/ownedFullArt.ts`' per-session read from full arts to every per-card cosmetic. The store keeps what it is given; the wear path and `useCanEquip` apply ownership.
- **Who wears them.** Every face that is the viewer's own copy: `worn`, or below `OwnCopy own` (`cards/fullArt.ts`), as full art already works. That is the board's own cards, the hover preview and inspect overlays of the viewer's own card (`Card.tsx` ~l.591 already wraps `inspect.overlay` in `<OwnCopy own={worn}>`; make `HoverPreview.tsx`, `InspectSheet.tsx` and `CardDetail.tsx` pass it to `CardFace`), and the Collection's card view (the sibling wraps it in `OwnCopy own`). An opponent's card, a watched game, a replay and every face not marked own draw the defaults (§14.2).

### The API (fixed: the Collection part calls it)
Keep every existing export and signature (`writeCosmetics`, `cosmeticsOf`, `DEFAULT_CARD_COSMETICS`, `resetCosmeticsForTests`: `e2e/cypress/component/card-cosmetics.cy.tsx` imports them). Add to `cards/cosmetics.ts`:
- `type CardPicks = { foil?: CosmeticId; finish?: CosmeticId; border?: CosmeticId; fullArt?: boolean }`
- `readCardPicks(defId: string): CardPicks` and `useCardPicks(defId: string): CardPicks`
- `writeCardPick(defId: string, kind: 'foil' | 'finish' | 'border', id: CosmeticId | null): void` (null clears to the account default)
- `writeCardFullArt(defId: string, on: boolean | null): void`
- `useCanEquip(): (defId: string, cosmeticId: CosmeticId) => boolean` (true wherever every cosmetic counts as owned)

### The ruling
`spec/rulings/R<N>000.md`, N this issue's number (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers). It covers: the picks per card on the device, the account defaults and the `cosmetics` group unchanged; a pick worn only when owned on its card, but in practice, hotseat and R1310004's builds; the viewer's own copy wearing its picks on the board, in the hover preview and inspect overlays and in the Collection's card view, everything else drawing the defaults; the Collection still the one place to equip (R1579000), per card in its card view with live previews, and the account cosmetics as preview tiles (the sibling builds those and names its tests after this ruling). It amends R1295000 (`The picks`, and `Whose cards wear them`: the hover preview, inspect overlays and the collection leave the defaults list) and R1313000 (a full art becomes a per-card pick). Hearthstone semantics: a player picks, card by card in the collection, which owned version of a card they play.

### Files
Under `apps/web/src/`: `cards/cosmetics.ts`, `cards/fullArt.ts`, `cards/ownedFullArt.ts`, `game/wearer.ts`, `game/Card.tsx`, `cards/inspect/HoverPreview.tsx`, `cards/inspect/InspectSheet.tsx`, `cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx`, `main.tsx` (only where `ViewerFullArt` mounts, if its props change), and the tests `cards/cosmetics.test.tsx`, `game/cosmetics.test.tsx`, `cards/fullArtOwnership.test.tsx`, `settings/wiring.test.tsx`, `settings/accountSync.test.tsx`. Spec: the new note; `spec/rulings/R1295000.md` and `R1313000.md` (titles gain `; amended by R<N>000`, nothing removed); one paragraph at the end of `spec/11-rulings.md`; one sentence in `spec/14-economy.md` §14.2 (a per-card cosmetic is equipped on the card it is owned for); `spec/INDEX.md` by `cargo jackioh spec index`. The global roll part and then the Purchases part edit these spec files after you.
Not here: `cards/cosmetics.css` (the border part), `collection/*` and `routes/collection.tsx` (the Collection part).

### Done when
Tests named `R<N>000 …`: picks are stored per card and never enter the `cosmetics` group or `PUT /api/settings`; a card wears its own picks on the board and in the inspect and hover preview while another card keeps the default; an opponent's copy of the same card draws the defaults; an unowned per-card cosmetic (a full art) is not worn outside practice and hotseat and `useCanEquip` says no, while under every-owned it is worn. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/cards/cosmetics.test.tsx src/game/cosmetics.test.tsx src/cards/fullArtOwnership.test.tsx src/settings/wiring.test.tsx src/settings/accountSync.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, `cargo jackioh spec index`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

**Fullsend.** A part of #1651: it lands on `bot/issue-1651` with no checks or review of its own, beside the other parts. Change only the files named here. A check red only because a sibling part has not landed yet is expected. Leave to the reconcile the `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` entry of each new `t()` string, `apps/web/README.md`, and every e2e spec. Keep every existing test id.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-1651`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #1651, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39819773251)).

## Plan

_Written by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39819773251)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

Read `spec/README.md`, §14.2, R1295000, R1297000, R1313000, R1310004, R1579000, R633, R634 and `apps/web/README.md`; then `cards/cosmetics.ts`, `cards/fullArt.ts`, `cards/ownedFullArt.ts`, `game/wearer.ts`, `game/Card.tsx` (~l.270–600), the three inspect components and where `ViewerFullArt` mounts in `main.tsx`.
2. `cards/cosmetics.ts`: add the per-card store under localStorage `jackioh.cosmetics.cards.v1` (load, persist, subscribe, `useSyncExternalStore`, a reset for tests), keeping unknown ids as `normalizeCosmetics` does, and the API in the body. Leave `settings/groups.ts`' `cosmetics` group as it is.
3. Make `wornCosmetics` / `useCosmeticAttributes` resolve each kind from the face's card's pick when it is owned, else the account default, on a face that is `worn` or below `OwnCopy own`.
4. Ownership: widen `FullArtOwned`'s context and `cards/ownedFullArt.ts`' per-session read from full arts to every per-card cosmetic owned per card (`getOwnedCosmetics().cards`, plus defaults and starters), `every` staying the practice and hotseat value; add `useCanEquip`.
5. `cards/fullArt.ts`: `useFullArt` reads the card's `fullArt` pick first, then the Full-art cards setting, always behind ownership.
6. Inspect: pass own to `CardFace` in `HoverPreview.tsx`, `InspectSheet.tsx` and `CardDetail.tsx`, so the viewer's own card wears its picks there and an opponent's stays plain.
7. Tests named `R<N>000 …` in `cards/cosmetics.test.tsx`, `game/cosmetics.test.tsx`, `cards/fullArtOwnership.test.tsx` and `settings/accountSync.test.tsx`; change `settings/wiring.test.tsx`'s `no full art is a pick (R1313000)` test to the per-card behaviour.
8. Spec: the note, the two amended titles, the §14.2 sentence and the `spec/11-rulings.md` paragraph; run `cargo jackioh spec index`, then `cargo jackioh spec check`.
9. Run the Done-when commands.
